en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Eighteenth Chapter
Is it true that the Blessed Buddha’s excrement and urine surpass all other types of perfumes?
"Does the Blessed One eat only fragrant food?
"...Is it not the case that the Blessed One eats boiled rice and sour gruel?"
“If the Blessed One eats boiled rice and sour gruel, then indeed it should not be said:
‘The excrement and urine of the Buddha, the Blessed One, surpasses other fragrant substances.’”
Is it true that the excrement and urine of the Buddha, the Blessed One, surpasses all other kinds of perfumes? Yes.

Is there anyone who bathes in the excrement and urine of the Buddha, the Blessed One; who anoints themselves with it, rubs it on, places it in a casket, stores it in a chest, displays it in a shop, and uses that fragrance for the purpose of making perfumes? [No.]
It should not be stated thus ... [as before] ...
The Discussion on the Nature of Odors is finished.
